fusions.name: Spoken Knot
fusions.desc: Speaks a knot of mesh into being on the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction the target carries, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Word of Closing
fusions.desc: You speak the closing word and a mesh snaps shut through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Binding Recital
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second incantation, your mesh closes on every creature within 5 tiles and holds them in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ward Between the Words
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, the practised words knot a ward of mesh around you that absorbs 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
